interests.en:
**Core fields:** metasurfaces · wavefront shaping · computational optics · physics-guided deep learning · holographic imaging · Fourier ptychography · computational spectroscopy & hyperspectral imaging.
I build optical encoders (disordered and inverse-designed metasurfaces, scattering media) paired with physics-informed reconstruction to enable compact, snapshot multimodal imaging (spectrum, phase and depth) that conventional optics cannot achieve.
